features.title: Self-hosted run end to end (real process, fake APIs)
criteria: The built process offers every Money Lab tool (web_search, view_page, browse, idea, harvest, check_design...) and none of spawn_child, expose_port, create_sandbox or topup_credits; the system prompt and tools are cached and the live state is a trailing system message
Every Anthropic request passes the strict validator (tool_use paired with tool_result, no empty text, at most 4 cache breakpoints) and the history cache hit rate stays at or above 50 %
A final text answer and a refusal end the turn without paid re-calls, and /aide is answered while a 15 s command runs

Across a restart /statut, /fonds, /pause and /reprendre work, no Telegram update is processed twice, no paid call happens while paused, autostart.sh restarts the site, and only the owner receives messages, none containing a key
Stripe revenue is booked once (10.80 USD confirmed for an EUR charge) across a restart and other currencies are skipped

Commands run without blocking the process and return despite background jobs within enforced timeouts, write_file is confined to $HOME, stop reasons map to loop actions and repetition is flagged only for identical calls
